info.syllabusName: Thực hành mô phỏng hệ thống ERP (Practice Simulation of ERP System)
info.description:
In business, resources
are limited. Therefore, in order to regulate and effectively and rationally use
these resources, it is necessary to have a modern tool that covers all activities
of the business so that business leaders can make optimal decisions in the
operating process of the enterprise. As a result, Enterprise Resource Planning
(ERP) is an effective platform that is often applied by businesses during their
operations. However, applying ERP professionally to make the most of all the
features of this platform is a real challenge for companies and corporations.
Understanding that, Mini ERP is an ERP simulation model based on Odoo’s ERP platform. This is an open
platform that helps students have a statistical process from overview to details
of functions affecting business activities in Enterprises of any size,
especially sales and supply chains. Students will act as representatives of
supply chain functions. The task is that with the provided data such as product
line information, supplier information, sales data, inventory data, etc.,
students have to solve problems to improve the Supply Chain situation.
